messages.subject: On plausible values (PL) simulation
parts:
Hi Phil,

Where could I find the technical details on how simulate plausible values using the normal approximation as well as the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm?

Many thanks,

Caio

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: On plausible values (PL) simulation
parts:
This is a pretty good overview of the idea (https://www.rasch.org/rmt/rmt182c.htm#:~:text=Plausible%20values%20are%20imputed%20values,the%20latent%20trait%20being%20measured.), though the assumption is based on the Gaussian distribution approximation for each posterior distribution. For the MHRM approach the posterior for each response vector is sampled from directly, which doesn't require the more strict reliance on Guassian distribution approximation shape (though it is much more expensive). HTH.

Phil
